facts.text: Deborah mentions that Anna has a pendant worn in memory of her mother.

evidence.quote: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.

facts.text: Deborah brings an amulet with her when reflecting on her mother, which she says helps her feel her mother's love and stay close to her.

evidence.quote: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.

facts.text: Jolene comments that small things can keep people close in our hearts every day.

evidence.quote: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.

facts.text: Deborah states that small things can make a big difference and are a reminder of love and strength, connecting people to those they've lost and comforting them.

evidence.quote: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
